summative_rubric.title: G3 Likely Unlikely — Summative Rubric
summative_rubric.purpose: Used during and after Lesson 5 to score against both expectations.

rows.expectation_text: use mathematical language, including the terms 'impossible', 'unlikely', 'equally likely', 'likely', and 'certain', to describe the likelihood of events happening, and use that likelihood to make predictions and informed decisions

levels.descriptor: Uses yes/no without scale words. Cannot place events on scale.
Uses 2-3 of the 5 words with prompts. Some misplacements.
Independently uses all 5 likelihood words to describe events and make predictions.
Uses scale words to make predictions and explains the resulting decision.

rows.expectation_text: make and test predictions about the likelihood that the mean and the mode(s) of a data set will be the same for data collected from different populations

levels.descriptor: Compares one population only. No mean/mode prediction.
Predicts same/different with prompts. Computes one of mean or mode.
Independently predicts and tests mean and mode across two populations.
Explains why predictions were right or wrong using the data.

summative_rubric.usage_notes: Score during Lesson 5 capstone. Level 3 = grade-level.

summative_task_script.title: Big Predict Capstone — Summative Administration Guide
summative_task_script.purpose: Ties Lesson 5 capstone, the 5 stations, and the rubric together.
administration_steps: Before: photocopy templates, print rubric, ready Junior Predictor certificates.
Stations 1-5 (5 min each): SCALE, PREDICT, POPULATIONS, MEAN+MODE, CONCLUDE.
Station 1 SCALE: place events on 5-zone scale. Evidence D2.1.
Station 2 PREDICT: 4 coin/dice predictions. Evidence D2.1.
Station 3 POPULATIONS: compare 2 favourites. Evidence D2.2.
Station 4 MEAN+MODE: predict and calculate. Evidence D2.2.
Station 5 CONCLUDE: scale word + mean + mode. Evidence D2.1 + D2.2.
summative_task_script.scoring_guidance: Use the Capstone Template as primary evidence. Level 3 = grade-level.

evidence_per_expectation.D2.1: Stations 1, 2, 5 — scale words used in predictions and conclusion.
evidence_per_expectation.D2.2: Stations 3, 4, 5 — two populations compared, mean+mode predicted and tested.
